## Selected Outcome

Update the password policy to require at least 8 characters and at least 3 of 4 character types: uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character. Validation messages must explain unmet requirements. Storage and scheduling behavior must not change.

## Acceptance Conditions

- Minimum password length is 8 characters.
- A password is accepted when it contains at least 3 of the 4 required character types.
- Passwords that do not meet the minimum length or character-type requirement are rejected.
- Password validation messages clearly explain which requirement is not met.
